result:
Tags are implemented end to end: authors can enter them on create and edit, they show on the list and post pages, and `/posts?tag=<name>` filters the list. `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass, including 7 new tests in `tests/PostTags.test.ts` that cover saving, replacing, filtering with page links, the five-tag and 30-character limits, trimming and de-duplication, and deleting a tagged post.

The schema has the `tags` and `post_tags` tables as specified, with a new migration (`db/migrations/20261018223615_add_tags`). The shared payload schema in `app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts` applies the field rules, so a refused tag list gets the same 422 response as an empty title, with the error on `tags`. `PostController` syncs the tag set on store and update and filters the list by tag. `PostResource` always emits `tags` as a sorted string array, and the post-tag links are on posts list and post pages. Codegen was re-run, so the `.guren/*.gen.ts` files are regenerated. A post's tag rows cascade on delete, so deleting a tagged post works.
